module.summary: Theme table: defines theme.name="default", the default skin (Evolved) and per-control-class skin overrides, plus helpers to pick the default skin and merge theme defaults.

theme.GetDefaultSkin.desc: Walks the class.inherited chain looking for a skinName on the control class or its ancestors and validates it with SkinHandler.IsValidSkin; falls back to general.skinName, then to "default".

theme.LoadThemeDefaults.desc: Merges the per-class defaults from theme.skin[classname] and the shared theme.skin.general defaults into control with table.merge.

fileDesc: Theme table and default-skin selection: defines theme.skin (default Evolved) and provides GetDefaultSkin and LoadThemeDefaults.
